items.name: 거세저항성 전립선암 진행 여부
items.def:
거세저항성 전립선암(CRPC) 정의
혈중 testosterone이 거세 수준인 50ng.dL 또는 1.7nmol/L 이하이면서 다음 중 한 가지를 만족해야한다.
- 혈중 전립선 특이항원 수치(serum PSA level)가 2ng/mL 이상이면서 최소 1주 이상 간격으로 3회 측정한 PSA 값이 2회 이상 상승
- 영상학 검사에서 RECIST 정의의 질병 진행에 합당하거나, 골스캔에서 2개 이상의 새로운 병변이 출현
items.req: 암종 조건부(해당 암종 연구 시 권장)

core.profile: KR Core 미정의 — FHIR R4 Observation 기본 리소스 파생

items.name: 재발 구분
items.def:
환자의 재발 구분
-생화학적 재발 : 근치적 전립선절제술 후 혈중 PSA 수치가 0.2ng/ml 이상으로 증가하거나, 방사선치료 후 PSA 기저치에서 2ng/mL 이상 상승한 경우
-국소 재발 : 수술이나 방사선치료, 국소치료 후 수술부위에 대한 영상검사 혹은 추적관찰 목적의 전립선 생검에서 재발 소견이 확인된 경우
-원격 재발 : 원격 림프절, 뼈, 폐나 간 등 원격 장기로 전이된 경우
-거세저항성 전립선암 : 
 혈중 testosterone이 거세 수준인 50ng.dL 또는 1.7nmol/L 이하이면서 다음 중 한 가지를 만족해야한다.
   * 혈중 전립선 특이항원 수치(serum PSA level)가 2ng/mL 이상이면서 최소 1주 이상 간격으로 3회 측정한 PSA 값이 2회 이상 상승
   * 영상학 검사에서 RECIST 정의의 질병 진행에 합당하거나, 골스캔에서 2개 이상의 새로운 병변이 출현
-호르몬 반응성 전이성 전립선암 :
전립선암이 조직검사를 통해 확진된 환자에서 MR, bone scan, chest/abd CT 등 영상학적 검사에서 전이 소견을 보이는 경우를 말하며, 일반적으로 호르몬 치료를 통해 testosterone 및 PSA 감소가 관찰된다면, 그리고 영상학적 소견에서 partial response 이상의 호전 경과를 보인다면 mHSPC 으로 판단

schemas.name: sample_registration
schemas.desc: The collection of data elements required to register the required Donor-Specimen-Sample data to the ARGO Data Platform. Registration of samples is required before molecular and clinical data submission can proceed.

schemas.name: donor
schemas.desc: The collection of data elements related to a specific donor in an ARGO program.

schemas.name: specimen
schemas.desc: The collection of data elements related to a donor's specimen. A specimen is any material sample taken for testing, diagnostic or research purposes.

schemas.name: primary_diagnosis
schemas.desc: The collection of data elements related to a donor's primary diagnosis. The primary diagnosis is the first diagnosed case of cancer in a donor. To submit multiple primary diagnoses for a single donor, submit multiple rows in the primary diagnosis file for this donor.

schemas.name: treatment
schemas.desc: The collection of data elements related to a donor's treatment at a specific point in the clinical record. To submit multiple treatments for a single donor, please submit treatment rows in the treatment file for this donor.

schemas.name: chemotherapy
schemas.desc: The collection of data elements describing the details of a chemotherapy treatment regimen completed by a donor. To submit multiple treatment drugs for a single regimen, submit multiple rows in the chemotherapy file.

schemas.name: hormone_therapy
schemas.desc: The collection of data elements describing the details of a hormone treatment therapy completed by a donor. To submit multiple treatment drugs for a single regimen, submit multiple rows in the hormone_therapy file.

schemas.name: radiation
schemas.desc: The collection of data elements describing the details of a radiation treatment completed by a donor.

schemas.name: immunotherapy
schemas.desc: The collection of data elements describing the details of an immunotherapy treatment completed by a donor.

schemas.name: surgery
schemas.desc: The collection of data elements related to a donor's surgical treatment at a specific point in the clinical record. To submit multiple surgeries, submit multiple rows in the Surgery file. If a specimen was resected during surgery, indicate the unique identifier of the specimen in the 'submitter_specimen_id' field. If multiple specimens were resected during a single surgical procedure, submit each 'submitter_specimen_id' as a new row with the same 'submitter_treatment_id' and 'surgery_type' values.

schemas.name: follow_up
schemas.desc: The collection of data elements related to a specific follow-up visit to a donor. A follow-up is defined as any point of contact with a patient after primary diagnosis. To submit multiple follow-ups for a single donor, please submit multiple rows in the follow-up file for this donor.

schemas.name: exposure
schemas.desc: The collection of data elements related to a donor's clinically relevant information not immediately resulting from genetic predispositions.

schemas.name: family_history
schemas.desc: The collection of data elements describing a donor's familial relationships and familial cancer history.

schemas.name: biomarker
schemas.desc: The collection of data elements describing a donor's biomarker tests. A biomarker is a biological molecule found in blood, other body fluids, or tissues that is indicative of the presence of cancer in the body. Each row should include one or more biomarker test(s) associated with a particular clinical event (submitter_specimen_id, submitter_primary_diagnosis_id, submitter_treatment_id or submitter_follow_up_id field). If the biomarker test is not associated with a particular clinical event, then indicate the time interval at which the biomarker test was performed (test_interval field).

schemas.name: comorbidity
schemas.desc: The collection of data elements related to a donor's comorbidities. A donor's comorbidities are any medical conditions (e.g diabetes, prior cancer malignancies) that have existed or may occur during the clinical course of the donor who has the index disease under study. To submit multiple comorbidities for a single donor, submit multiple rows in the comorbidity file for this donor.

sample_registration.program_id.label: Program ID
sample_registration.program_id.desc: Unique identifier of the ARGO program.

sample_registration.submitter_donor_id.label: Submitter Donor ID
sample_registration.submitter_donor_id.desc: Unique identifier of the donor, assigned by the data provider.

sample_registration.gender.label: Gender
sample_registration.gender.desc: Description of the donor self-reported gender. Gender is described as the assemblage of properties that distinguish people on the basis of their societal roles.

sample_registration.submitter_specimen_i.label: Submitter Specimen ID
sample_registration.submitter_specimen_i.desc: Unique identifier of the specimen, assigned by the data provider.

sample_registration.tumour_normal_design.label: Tumour Normal Designation
sample_registration.tumour_normal_design.desc: Description of specimens tumour/normal status for data processing.

sample_registration.specimen_type.label: Specimen Type
sample_registration.specimen_type.desc: Description of the kind of specimen that was collected with respect to tumour/normal tissue origin.
values: Cell line - derived from metastatic tumour
Cell line - derived from xenograft tumour
Metastatic tumour - metastasis local to lymph node
Metastatic tumour - metastasis to distant location
Normal - tissue adjacent to primary tumour
Tumour - unknown if derived from primary or metastatic
Xenograft - derived from tumour cell line

sample_registration.submitter_sample_id.label: Submitter Sample ID
sample_registration.submitter_sample_id.desc: Unique identifier of the sample, assigned by the data provider.

sample_registration.sample_type.label: Sample Type
sample_registration.sample_type.desc: Description of the type of molecular sample used for testing.

donor.program_id.label: Program ID
donor.program_id.desc: Unique identifier of the ARGO program.

donor.submitter_donor_id.label: Submitter Donor ID
donor.submitter_donor_id.desc: Unique identifier of the donor, assigned by the data provider.

donor.vital_status.label: Vital Status
donor.vital_status.desc: Donor's last known state of living or deceased.

donor.cause_of_death.label: Cause of Death
donor.cause_of_death.desc: Indicate the cause of a donor's death.

donor.survival_time.label: Survival Time
donor.survival_time.desc: Interval of how long the donor has survived since primary diagnosis, in days.

donor.primary_site.label: Primary Site
donor.primary_site.desc: The text term used to describe the primary site of disease, as categorized by the World Health Organization's (WHO) International Classification of Diseases for Oncology (ICD-O). This categorization groups cases into general categories.
values: Bones, joints and articular cartilage of limbs
Bones, joints and articular cartilage of other and unspecified sites
Connective, subcutaneous and other soft tissues
Other and ill-defined sites in lip, oral cavity and pharynx
Other and ill-defined sites within respiratory system and intrathoracic organs
Other and unspecified female genital organs
Other and unspecified major salivary glands
Other and unspecified male genital organs
Other and unspecified parts of biliary tract
Other and unspecified parts of mouth
Other and unspecified parts of tongue
Other endocrine glands and related structures
Peripheral nerves and autonomic nervous system
Spinal cord, cranial nerves, and other parts of central nervous system

donor.height.label: Height
donor.height.desc: Indicate the donor's height, in centimeters (cm).

donor.weight.label: Weight
donor.weight.desc: Indicate the donor's weight, in kilograms (kg).

donor.bmi.label: BMI
donor.bmi.desc: Indicate the donor's Body Mass Index (BMI) in kg/m².

donor.genetic_disorders.label: Genetic Disorders
donor.genetic_disorders.desc: Indicate presence of any hereditary genetic disorders. Genetic diseases are diseases in which inherited genes predispose to increased risk. The genetic disorders associated with cancer often result from an alteration or mutation in a single gene. The diseases range from rare dominant cancer family syndrome to familial tendencies in which low-penetrance genes may interact with other genes or environmental factors to induce cancer. (References: NCIt C3101. Genetic disorder names were standardized using Orphanet (https://www.orpha.net/) and NCI Thesaurus)
values: Familial Atypical Multiple Mole Melanoma Syndrome (FAMMM)
Hereditary Breast and Ovarian Cancer Syndrome (HBOC)
Hereditary Leiomyomatosis and Renal Cell Cancer (HLRCC)

donor.menopause_status.label: Menopause Status
donor.menopause_status.desc: Indicate the donor's menopause status at the time of primary diagnosis. (Reference: caDSR CDE ID 2434914)

donor.age_at_menarche.label: Age at Menarche
donor.age_at_menarche.desc: Indicate the donor's age, in years, at which the first menstruation event occurred. (Reference: NCIt C19666)

donor.number_of_pregnancies.label: Number of Pregnancies
donor.number_of_pregnancies.desc: Indicate the total number of pregnancy events experienced by the donor. (Reference: NCIt C106551)

donor.number_of_children.label: Number of Children
donor.number_of_children.desc: Indicate the number of children the donor has birthed. (Reference: caDSR CDE ID 2486644)

donor.hrt_type.label: Hormone Replacement Therapy Type
donor.hrt_type.desc: Indicate the type of hormone replacement therapy (HRT) the donor has taken or is currently taking.

donor.hrt_duration.label: Hormone Replacement Therapy Duration
donor.hrt_duration.desc: If donor has taken hormone replacement therapy (HRT), indicate how long donor has been taking HRT, in months. (Reference: caDSR CDE ID 5365433)

donor.contraception_type.label: Contraception Type
donor.contraception_type.desc: Indicate the type of hormonal contraception the donor has taken or is currently taking. (Reference: caDSR CDE ID 3264234)

donor.contraception_duration.label: Hormonal Contraception Duration
donor.contraception_duration.desc: If donor has taken hormonal contraception, indicate duration of use, in months. (Reference: caDSR CDE ID 5206887)

donor.lost_to_followup_after_clinical_ev.label: Lost To Follow Up After Clinical Event
donor.lost_to_followup_after_clinical_ev.desc: If the donor became lost to follow up, indicate the identifier of the clinical event (eg. submitter_primary_diagnosis_id, submitter_treatment_id or submitter_follow_up_id) after which the donor became lost to follow up.

donor.country_of_residence_at_enrollment.label: Country of Residence at Enrollment
donor.country_of_residence_at_enrollment.desc: Indicate the donor's country of residence at the time they were enrolled in the study. The country list include 193 UN member states plus 2 UN observer states. Source: https://www.un.org/en/about-us/member-states
values: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

specimen.program_id.label: Program ID
specimen.program_id.desc: Unique identifier of the ARGO program.

specimen.submitter_donor_id.label: Submitter Donor ID
specimen.submitter_donor_id.desc: Unique identifier of the donor, assigned by the data provider.

specimen.submitter_specimen_id.label: Submitter Specimen ID
specimen.submitter_specimen_id.desc: Unique identifier of the specimen, assigned by the data provider.

specimen.submitter_primary_diagnosis_id.label: Submitter Primary Diagnosis ID
specimen.submitter_primary_diagnosis_id.desc: Indicate the primary diagnosis event in the clinical timeline that this specimen acquisition was related to.

specimen.pathological_tumour_staging_sys.label: Pathological Tumour Staging System
specimen.pathological_tumour_staging_sys.desc: Specify the tumour staging system used to assess the cancer at the time the tumour specimen was resected. Pathological classification is based on the clinical stage information (acquired before treatment) and supplemented/modified by operative findings and pathological evaluation of the resected specimen.

specimen.pathological_t_category.label: Pathological T Category
specimen.pathological_t_category.desc: The code to represent the stage of cancer defined by the size or contiguous extension of the primary tumour (T), according to criteria based on multiple editions of the AJCC's Cancer Staging Manual.

specimen.pathological_n_category.label: Pathological N Category
specimen.pathological_n_category.desc: The code to represent the stage of cancer defined by whether or not the cancer has reached nearby lymph nodes (N), according to criteria based on multiple editions of the AJCC's Cancer Staging Manual.

specimen.pathological_m_category.label: Pathological M Category
specimen.pathological_m_category.desc: The code to represent the stage of cancer defined by whether there are distant metastases (M), meaning spread of cancer to other parts of the body, according to criteria based on multiple editions of the AJCC's Cancer Staging Manual.

specimen.pathological_stage_group.label: Pathological Stage Group
specimen.pathological_stage_group.desc: Specify the tumour stage, based on pathological_tumour_staging_system, used to assess the cancer at the time the tumour specimen was resected.

specimen.specimen_acquisition_interval.label: Specimen Acquisition Interval
specimen.specimen_acquisition_interval.desc: Interval between primary diagnosis and specimen acquisition, in days.

specimen.tumour_histological_type.label: Tumour Histological Type
specimen.tumour_histological_type.desc: The code to represent the histology (morphology) of neoplasms that is usually obtained from a pathology report, according to the International Classification of Diseases for Oncology, 3rd Edition (WHO ICD-O-3). Refer to the ICD-O-3 manual for guidelines at https://apps.who.int/iris/handle/10665/42344.

specimen.specimen_anatomic_location.label: Specimen Anatomic Location
specimen.specimen_anatomic_location.desc: Indicate the ICD-O-3 topography code for the anatomic location of a specimen when it was collected. Refer to the guidelines provided in the ICD-O-3 manual at https://apps.who.int/iris/handle/10665/42344.

specimen.specimen_laterality.label: Specimen Laterality
specimen.specimen_laterality.desc: For cancer in a paired organ, indicate the side on which the specimen was obtained. (Reference caDSR CDE ID 2007875)

specimen.specimen_processing.label: Specimen Processing
specimen.specimen_processing.desc: Indicate the technique used to process specimen.
values: Cryopreservation of live cells in liquid nitrogen

specimen.specimen_storage.label: Specimen Storage
specimen.specimen_storage.desc: Indicate the method of specimen storage for specimen that were not extracted freshly or immediately cultured.

specimen.reference_pathology_confirmed.label: Reference Pathology Confirmed
specimen.reference_pathology_confirmed.desc: Indicate whether the pathological diagnosis was confirmed by a (central) reference pathologist. (Reference caDSR CDE ID 2007007)

specimen.tumour_grading_system.label: Tumour Grading System
specimen.tumour_grading_system.desc: Specify the tumour staging system used to assess the description of a tumour based on how abnormal the tumour cells and the tumour tissue look under a microscope. Tumour grade is an indicator of how quickly a tumour is likely to grow.
values: WHO grading system for CNS tumours

specimen.tumour_grade.label: Tumour Grade
specimen.tumour_grade.desc: Grade of the tumour as assigned by the reporting tumour_grading_system.

specimen.percent_tumour_cells.label: Percent Tumour Cells
specimen.percent_tumour_cells.desc: Indicate a value, in decimals, that represents the percent of tumour cells compared to the number of total cells in a specimen. (Reference: NCIt: C159484)

specimen.percent_tumour_cells_measuremen.label: Percent Tumour Cells Measurement Method
specimen.percent_tumour_cells_measuremen.desc: Indicate method used to measure percent_tumour_cells.

specimen.percent_proliferating_cells.label: Percent Proliferating Cells
specimen.percent_proliferating_cells.desc: Indicate a value, in decimals, that represents the count of proliferating cells determined during pathologic review of the specimen.

specimen.percent_inflammatory_tissue.label: Percent Inflammatory Tissue
specimen.percent_inflammatory_tissue.desc: Indicate a value, in decimals, that represents the percent of a specimen that is positive for inflammatory markers, including the presence of capillary dilatation, edema and increased leukocytes. (Reference NCIt C159479)

specimen.percent_stromal_cells.label: Percent Stromal Cells
specimen.percent_stromal_cells.desc: Indicate a value, in decimals, that represents the percentage of reactive cells that are present in a tumour specimen but are not malignant such as fibroblasts, vascular structures, etc. (Reference caDSR CDE ID 2841241)

specimen.percent_necrosis.label: Percent Necrosis
specimen.percent_necrosis.desc: Indicate a value, in decimals, that represents the percent of cells undergoing necrosis compared to the number of total cells present in a tumour specimen. (Reference NCIt C159481)

primary_diagnosis.program_id.label: Program ID
primary_diagnosis.program_id.desc: Unique identifier of the ARGO program.

primary_diagnosis.submitter_donor_id.label: Submitter Donor ID
primary_diagnosis.submitter_donor_id.desc: Unique identifier of the donor, assigned by the data provider.

primary_diagnosis.submitter_primary_diag.label: Submitter Primary Diagnosis ID
primary_diagnosis.submitter_primary_diag.desc: Unique identifier of the primary diagnosis event, assigned by the data provider.

primary_diagnosis.age_at_diagnosis.label: Age at Diagnosis
primary_diagnosis.age_at_diagnosis.desc: Age that the donor was first diagnosed with cancer, in years. This should be based on the earliest diagnosis of cancer.

primary_diagnosis.cancer_type_code.label: Cancer Type Code
primary_diagnosis.cancer_type_code.desc: The code to represent the cancer type using the WHO ICD-10 code (https://icd.who.int/browse10/2019/en) classification.

primary_diagnosis.cancer_type_additional.label: Cancer Type Additional Information
primary_diagnosis.cancer_type_additional.desc: Additional details related to the cancer type that are not covered by the ICD-10 code provided in the cancer_type field.

primary_diagnosis.basis_of_diagnosis.label: Basis of Diagnosis
primary_diagnosis.basis_of_diagnosis.desc: Indicate the most valid basis of how the primary diagnosis was identified. If more than one diagnosis technique was used, select the term that has the highest code number (see notes). (Reference: IACR Standard for Basis of Diagnosis http://www.iacr.com.fr/images/doc/basis.pdf)

primary_diagnosis.laterality.label: Laterality
primary_diagnosis.laterality.desc: For cancer in a paired organ, indicate the side of the body on which the primary tumour or cancer first developed at the time of primary diagnosis. (Reference caDSR CDE ID 827)

primary_diagnosis.lymph_nodes_examined_s.label: Lymph Nodes Examined Status
primary_diagnosis.lymph_nodes_examined_s.desc: Indicate if lymph nodes were examined for metastases.
values: No lymph nodes found in resected specimen

primary_diagnosis.lymph_nodes_examined_m.label: Method Used to Examine Lymph Nodes
primary_diagnosis.lymph_nodes_examined_m.desc: Indicate the method used to examine lymph nodes.

primary_diagnosis.number_lymph_nodes_exa.label: Number Of Lymph Nodes Examined
primary_diagnosis.number_lymph_nodes_exa.desc: The total number of lymph nodes tested for the presence of cancer. (Reference: caDSR CDE ID 3)

primary_diagnosis.number_lymph_nodes_pos.label: Number Of Lymph Nodes Positive
primary_diagnosis.number_lymph_nodes_pos.desc: The number of regional lymph nodes reported as being positive for tumour metastases. (Reference: caDSR CDE ID 6113694)

primary_diagnosis.clinical_tumour_stagin.label: Clinical Tumour Staging System
primary_diagnosis.clinical_tumour_stagin.desc: Indicate the tumour staging system used to stage the cancer at the time of primary diagnosis (prior to treatment).

primary_diagnosis.clinical_t_category.label: Clinical T Category
primary_diagnosis.clinical_t_category.desc: The code to represent the extent of the primary tumour (T) based on evidence obtained from clinical assessment parameters determined at time of primary diagnosis and prior to treatment, according to criteria based on multiple editions of the AJCC's Cancer Staging Manual.

primary_diagnosis.clinical_n_category.label: Clinical N Category
primary_diagnosis.clinical_n_category.desc: The code to represent the stage of cancer defined by the extent of the regional lymph node (N) involvement for the cancer based on evidence obtained from clinical assessment parameters determined at time of primary diagnosis and prior to treatment, according to criteria based on multiple editions of the AJCC's Cancer Staging Manual.

primary_diagnosis.clinical_m_category.label: Clinical M Category
primary_diagnosis.clinical_m_category.desc: The code to represent the stage of cancer defined by the extent of the distant metastasis (M) for the cancer based on evidence obtained from clinical assessment parameters determined at time of primary diagnosis and prior to treatment, according to criteria based on multiple editions of the AJCC's Cancer Staging Manual. MX is NOT a valid category and cannot be assigned.

primary_diagnosis.clinical_stage_group.label: Clinical Stage Group
primary_diagnosis.clinical_stage_group.desc: Stage group of the tumour, as assigned by the reporting clinical_tumour_staging_system, that indicates the overall prognostic tumour stage.

primary_diagnosis.presenting_symptoms.label: Presenting Symptoms
primary_diagnosis.presenting_symptoms.desc: Indicate presenting symptoms at time of primary diagnosis.

primary_diagnosis.performance_status.label: Performance Status
primary_diagnosis.performance_status.desc: Indicate the donor's performance status grade at the time of primary diagnosis. (Reference: ECOG performance score grades from https://ecog-acrin.org/resources/ecog-performance-status).

treatment.program_id.label: Program ID
treatment.program_id.desc: Unique identifier of the ARGO program.

treatment.submitter_donor_id.label: Submitter Donor ID
treatment.submitter_donor_id.desc: Unique identifier of the donor, assigned by the data provider.

treatment.submitter_treatment_id.label: Submitter Treatment ID
treatment.submitter_treatment_id.desc: Unique identifier of the treatment, assigned by the data provider.

treatment.submitter_primary_diagnosis_id.label: Submitter Primary Diagnosis ID
treatment.submitter_primary_diagnosis_id.desc: Indicate the primary diagnosis event in the clinical timeline that this treatment was related to.

treatment.treatment_type.label: Treatment Type
treatment.treatment_type.desc: Indicate the type of treatment regimen that the donor completed.

treatment.is_primary_treatment.label: Is Primary Treatment
treatment.is_primary_treatment.desc: Indicate if the treatment was the primary treatment following the initial diagnosis.

treatment.line_of_treatment.label: Line Of treatment
treatment.line_of_treatment.desc: Indicate the line of treatment if it is not the primary treatment.

treatment.treatment_start_interval.label: Treatment Start Interval
treatment.treatment_start_interval.desc: The interval between the primary diagnosis and initiation of treatment, in days.

treatment.treatment_duration.label: Treatment Duration
treatment.treatment_duration.desc: The duration of treatment regimen, in days.

treatment.days_per_cycle.label: Days Per Cycle
treatment.days_per_cycle.desc: Indicate the number of days in a treatment cycle.

treatment.number_of_cycles.label: Number Of Cycles
treatment.number_of_cycles.desc: Indicate the number of treatment cycles.

treatment.treatment_intent.label: Treatment Intent
treatment.treatment_intent.desc: Indicate the purpose of the treatment, or the desired effect or outcome resulting from the treatment. (Reference: mCODE/FHIR)

treatment.treatment_setting.label: Treatment Setting
treatment.treatment_setting.desc: Indicate the treatment setting, which describes the treatment's purpose in relation to the primary treatment. (Reference: NCIt C124308)

treatment.response_to_treatment_criteria.label: Response To Treatment Criteria Method
treatment.response_to_treatment_criteria.desc: Indicate the criteria used to assess the donor's response to the applied treatment regimen.
values: ELN Dohner AML 2017 Oncology Response Criteria
IWG Cheson AML 2003 Oncology Response Criteria

treatment.response_to_treatment.label: Response To Treatment
treatment.response_to_treatment.desc: The donor's response to the applied treatment regimen.
values: Complete remission with incomplete hematologic recovery (CRi)
Complete remission without minimal residual disease (CRMRD-)
Morphologic complete remission with incomplete blood count recovery (CRi)

treatment.outcome_of_treatment.label: Outcome Of Treatment
treatment.outcome_of_treatment.desc: Indicate the donor's outcome of the prescribed treatment.
values: Treatment incomplete due to technical or organizational problems
Treatment stopped due to lack of efficacy (disease progression)
Treatment stopped due to acute toxicity

treatment.toxicity_type.label: Toxicity Type
treatment.toxicity_type.desc: If the treatment was terminated early due to acute toxicity, indicate whether it was due to hematological toxicity or non-hematological toxicity.

treatment.hematological_toxicity.label: Hemotological Toxicity
treatment.hematological_toxicity.desc: Indicate the hematological toxicities which caused early termination of the treatment. (Codelist reference: NCI-CTCAE (v5.0))

treatment.non-hematological_toxicity.label: Non-hematological Toxicity
treatment.non-hematological_toxicity.desc: Indicate the non-hematological toxicities which caused early termination of the treatment. (Codelist reference: NCI-CTCAE (v5.0))

treatment.adverse_events.label: Adverse Events
treatment.adverse_events.desc: Report any treatment related adverse events. (Codelist reference: NCI-CTCAE (v5.0))
values: Blood and lymphatic system disorders - Other, specify
Congenital, familial and genetic disorders - Other, specify
Ear and labyrinth disorders - Other, specify
General disorders and administration site conditions - Other, specify
Injury, poisoning and procedural complications - Other, specify
Joint range of motion decreased cervical spine
Joint range of motion decreased lumbar spine
Metabolism and nutrition disorders - Other, specify
Musculoskeletal and connective tissue disorder - Other, specify
Neoplasms benign, malignant and unspecified (incl cysts and polyps) - Other, specify
Pregnancy, puerperium and perinatal conditions - Other, specify
Renal and urinary disorders - Other, specify
Reproductive system and breast disorders - Other, specify
Respiratory, thoracic and mediastinal disorders - Other, specify
Skin and subcutaneous tissue disorders - Other, specify
Surgical and medical procedures - Other, specify

treatment.clinical_trials_database.label: Clinical Trials Database
treatment.clinical_trials_database.desc: If the donor is a participant in a clinical trial, indicate the clinical trial database where the clinical trial is registered.

treatment.clinical_trial_number.label: Clinical Trial Number
treatment.clinical_trial_number.desc: Based on the clinical_trial_database, indicate the unique NCT or EudraCT clinical trial identifier of which the donor is a participant.

chemotherapy.submitter_treatment_id.desc: Unique identifier of the treatment, as assigned by the data provider.

chemotherapy.drug_rxnormcui.label: RxNormCUI
chemotherapy.drug_rxnormcui.desc: The unique RxNormID assigned to the treatment regimen drug.

chemotherapy.drug_name.label: Chemotherapy Drug Name
chemotherapy.drug_name.desc: Name of agent or drug administered to donor as part of the treatment regimen.

chemotherapy.drug_database.label: Drug Database
chemotherapy.drug_database.desc: Indicate the drug database where drug term is found.

chemotherapy.drug_id.label: Drug ID
chemotherapy.drug_id.desc: Indicate the identifier from the drug_database for the drug.

chemotherapy.drug_term.label: Drug Term
chemotherapy.drug_term.desc: Indicate the drug term as it exists in the database specified in the drug_database.

chemotherapy.chemotherapy_drug_dose_unit.label: Chemotherapy Drug Dose Units
chemotherapy.chemotherapy_drug_dose_unit.desc: Indicate units used to record chemotherapy drug dose.

chemotherapy.prescribed_cumulative_drug_.label: Prescribed Cumulative Drug Dose
chemotherapy.prescribed_cumulative_drug_.desc: Indicate the total prescribed cumulative drug dose in the same units specified in chemotherapy_drug_dose_units.

chemotherapy.actual_cumulative_drug_dose.label: Actual Cumulative Drug Dose
chemotherapy.actual_cumulative_drug_dose.desc: Indicate the total actual cumulative drug dose in the same units specified in chemotherapy_drug_dose_units.

chemotherapy.dose_intensity_reduction.label: Dose Intensity Reduction
chemotherapy.dose_intensity_reduction.desc: Indicate if there was a significant reduction in dose intensity.

chemotherapy.dose_intensity_reduction_ev.label: Dose Intensity Reduction Event
chemotherapy.dose_intensity_reduction_ev.desc: If there was a signficiant reduction in dose intensity, indicate which event caused it.

chemotherapy.dose_intensity_reduction_am.label: Amount of Dose Intensity Reduction
chemotherapy.dose_intensity_reduction_am.desc: If there was a significant reduction in dose intensity, indicate the amount.

hormone_therapy.program_id.desc: Unique identifier of the ARGO program.

hormone_therapy.submitter_donor_id.desc: Unique identifier of the donor, assigned by the data provider.

hormone_therapy.submitter_treatment_id.desc: Unique identifier of the treatment, assigned by the data provider.

hormone_therapy.drug_rxnormcui.desc: The unique RxNormID assigned to the treatment regimen drug.

hormone_therapy.hormone_drug_dose_units.label: Hormone Drug Dose Units
hormone_therapy.hormone_drug_dose_units.desc: Indicate the units used to record hormone drug dose.

hormone_therapy.prescribed_cumulative_dr.label: Prescribed Cumulative Drug Dose

hormone_therapy.actual_cumulative_drug_d.label: Actual Cumulative Drug Dose
hormone_therapy.actual_cumulative_drug_d.desc: Indicate the total actual cumulative drug dose in the same units specified in hormone_drug_dose_units.

radiation.program_id.label: Program ID
radiation.program_id.desc: Unique identifier of the ARGO program.

radiation.submitter_donor_id.label: Submitter Donor ID
radiation.submitter_donor_id.desc: Unique identifier of the donor, assigned by the data provider.

radiation.submitter_treatment_id.label: Submitter Treatment ID
radiation.submitter_treatment_id.desc: Unique identifier of the treatment, assigned by the data provider.

radiation.radiation_therapy_modality.label: Radiation Therapy Modality
radiation.radiation_therapy_modality.desc: Indicate the method of radiation treatment or modality.

radiation.radiation_therapy_type.label: Type of Radiation Therapy
radiation.radiation_therapy_type.desc: Indicate type of radiation therapy administered.

radiation.radiation_therapy_fractions.label: Radiation Therapy Fractions
radiation.radiation_therapy_fractions.desc: Indicate the total number of fractions delivered as part of treatment.

radiation.radiation_therapy_dosage.label: Radiation Therapy Dosage
radiation.radiation_therapy_dosage.desc: Indicate the total dose given in units of Gray (Gy).

radiation.anatomical_site_irradiated.label: Anatomical Site Irradiated
radiation.anatomical_site_irradiated.desc: Indicate body region where radiation therapy was administered. (Reference: Cancer Care Ontario)

radiation.radiation_boost.label: Radiation Boost
radiation.radiation_boost.desc: A radiation boost is an extra radiation treatment targeted at the tumor bed, given after the regular sessions of radiation is complete (Reference NCIt: C137812). Indicate if this radiation treatment was a radiation boost.

radiation.reference_radiation_treatment_.label: Reference Radiation Treatment for Boost
radiation.reference_radiation_treatment_.desc: If a radiation boost was given, indicate the 'submitter_treatment_id' of the primary radiation treatment the radiation boost treatment is linked to.

immunotherapy.program_id.label: Program ID
immunotherapy.program_id.desc: Unique identifier of the ARGO program.

immunotherapy.submitter_donor_id.label: Submitter Donor ID
immunotherapy.submitter_donor_id.desc: Unique identifier of the donor, assigned by the data provider.

immunotherapy.submitter_treatment_id.label: Submitter Treatment ID
immunotherapy.submitter_treatment_id.desc: Unique identifier of the treatment, assigned by the data provider.

immunotherapy.immunotherapy_type.label: Immunotherapy Type
immunotherapy.immunotherapy_type.desc: Indicate the type of immunotherapy administered to donor.
values: Monoclonal antibodies other than immune checkpoint inhibitors

immunotherapy.drug_rxnormcui.label: RxNormCUI
immunotherapy.drug_rxnormcui.desc: The unique RxNormID assigned to the treatment regimen drug.

immunotherapy.drug_name.desc: Name of agent or drug administered to donor as part of the treatment regimen.

surgery.program_id.label: Program ID
surgery.program_id.desc: Unique identifier of the ARGO program.

surgery.submitter_donor_id.label: Submitter Donor ID
surgery.submitter_donor_id.desc: Unique identifier of the donor, assigned by the data provider.

surgery.submitter_specimen_id.label: Submitter Specimen ID
surgery.submitter_specimen_id.desc: If a specimen was resected during surgery, indicate the unique identifier of the specimen here. This submitter_specimen_id should exist in the Specimen file.

surgery.submitter_treatment_id.label: Submitter Treatment ID
surgery.submitter_treatment_id.desc: Unique identifier of the treatment, assigned by the data provider.

surgery.surgery_type.label: Surgery Type
surgery.surgery_type.desc: Indicate the type of surgical procedure that was performed. (References: SNOMED, NCIt, UMLS)
values: Debridement of pancreatic and peripancreatic necrosis

surgery.surgery_site.label: Surgery Site
surgery.surgery_site.desc: Indicate the ICD-O-3 topography code for the anatomic site where the surgical procedure was performed, according to the International Classification of Diseases for Oncology, 3rd Edition (WHO ICD-O-3).

surgery.surgery_location.label: Surgery Location
surgery.surgery_location.desc: Indicate whether the surgical procedure was done at the primary, local recurrence or metastatic location.

surgery.tumour_length.label: Tumour Length
surgery.tumour_length.desc: Indicate the length of the tumour, in millimetres (mm).

surgery.tumour_width.label: Tumour Width
surgery.tumour_width.desc: Indicate the width of the tumour, in millimetres (mm).

surgery.greatest_dimension_tumour.label: Greatest Dimension Tumour
surgery.greatest_dimension_tumour.desc: Indicate the greatest dimension or diameter of the tumour, in millimetres (mm). (Reference: NCIt C157135)

surgery.tumour_focality.label: Tumour Focality
surgery.tumour_focality.desc: Indicate the characterization of the location of the tumour. (Reference: NCIt: C157425)

surgery.residual_tumour_classification.label: Residual Tumour Classification
surgery.residual_tumour_classification.desc: Indicate the absence or presence of residual tumour after treatment. In some cases treated with surgery and/or with neoadjuvant therapy there will be residual tumour at the primary site after treatment because of incomplete resection or local and regional disease that extends beyond the limit of ability of resection. (Reference: AJCC 8th ed.)

surgery.margin_types_not_involved.label: Margin Types Not Involved
surgery.margin_types_not_involved.desc: Indicate the margin type(s) not involved.

surgery.margin_types_not_assessed.label: Margin Types Not Assessed
surgery.margin_types_not_assessed.desc: Indicate the margin type(s) that cannot be assessed.

surgery.lymphovascular_invasion.label: Lymphovascular Invasion (LVI)
surgery.lymphovascular_invasion.desc: Indicate the absence or presence of lymphovascular invasion (LVI). LVI includes lymphatic invasion, vascular invasion and lymphovascular invasion. (Reference: AJCC 8th ed.)
values: Both lymphatic and small vessel and venous (large vessel) invasion
Lymphatic and small vessel invasion only

surgery.perineural_invasion.label: Perineural Invasion
surgery.perineural_invasion.desc: A morphologic finding referring to a tumour that has spread along and infiltrated nerve fibers. Indicate the presence or absence of perineural invasion. (Reference: NCIt: C48260, ICCR)

surgery.extrathyroidal_extension.label: Extrathyroidal Extension
surgery.extrathyroidal_extension.desc: Indicate the involvement of perithyroidal soft tissues by direct extension from the thyroid primary. (Reference: AJCC 8th Ed.)

follow_up.program_id.label: Program ID
follow_up.program_id.desc: Unique identifier of the ARGO program.

follow_up.submitter_donor_id.label: Submitter Donor ID
follow_up.submitter_donor_id.desc: Unique identifier of the donor, assigned by the data provider.

follow_up.submitter_follow_up_id.label: Submitter Follow-Up ID
follow_up.submitter_follow_up_id.desc: Unique identifier for a follow-up event in a donor's clinical record, assigned by the data provider.

follow_up.interval_of_followup.label: Interval Of Follow-Up
follow_up.interval_of_followup.desc: Interval from the primary diagnosis date to the follow-up date, in days.

follow_up.disease_status_at_followup.label: Disease Status at Follow-Up
follow_up.disease_status_at_followup.desc: Indicate the donor's disease status at time of follow-up. (Reference: RECIST)

follow_up.submitter_primary_diagnosis_id.label: Submitter Primary Diagnosis ID
follow_up.submitter_primary_diagnosis_id.desc: Indicate if the follow-up is related to a specific primary diagnosis event in the clinical timeline.

follow_up.submitter_treatment_id.label: Submitter Treatment ID
follow_up.submitter_treatment_id.desc: Indicate if the follow-up is related to a specific treatment event in the clinical timeline.

follow_up.weight_at_followup.label: Weight at Follow-Up
follow_up.weight_at_followup.desc: Indicate the donor's weight, in kilograms (kg), at the time of follow-up.

follow_up.relapse_interval.label: Relapse Interval
follow_up.relapse_interval.desc: If the donor was clinically disease free following primary treatment and then relapse or recurrence or progression (for liquid tumours) occurred afterwards, then this field will indicate the length of disease free interval, in days.

follow_up.method_of_progression_status.label: Method Of Progression Status
follow_up.method_of_progression_status.desc: Indicate the method(s) used to confirm the donor's progression or relapse or recurrence disease status. (Reference: caDSR CDE ID 6161031)
values: Biomarker in liquid biopsy (e.g. tumour marker in blood or urine)

follow_up.anatomic_site_progression_or_r.label: Anatomic Site Progression or Recurrences
follow_up.anatomic_site_progression_or_r.desc: Indicate the ICD-O-3 topography code for the anatomic site(s) where disease progression, relapse or recurrence occurred, according to the International Classification of Diseases for Oncology, 3rd Edition (WHO ICD-O-3). Refer to the ICD-O-3 manual for guidelines at https://apps.who.int/iris/handle/10665/42344.

follow_up.recurrence_tumour_staging_syst.label: Recurrance Tumour Staging System
follow_up.recurrence_tumour_staging_syst.desc: Specify the tumour staging system used to stage the cancer at time of retreatment for recurrence or disease progression. This may be represented as rTNM in the medical report.

follow_up.recurrence_t_category.label: Recurrence T Category
follow_up.recurrence_t_category.desc: The code to represent the extent of the primary tumour (T) based on evidence obtained from clinical assessment parameters determined at the time of retreatment for a recurrence or disease progression, according to criteria based on multiple editions of the AJCC's Cancer Staging Manual.

follow_up.recurrence_n_category.label: Recurrence N Category
follow_up.recurrence_n_category.desc: The code to represent the stage of cancer defined by the extent of the regional lymph node (N) involvement for the cancer based on evidence obtained from clinical assessment parameters determined at the time of retreatment for a recurrence or disease progression, according to criteria based on multiple editions of the AJCC's Cancer Staging Manual.

follow_up.recurrence_m_category.label: Recurrence M Category
follow_up.recurrence_m_category.desc: The code to represent the stage of cancer defined by the extent of the distant metastasis (M) for the cancer based on evidence obtained from clinical assessment parameters determined at the time of retreatment for a recurrence or disease progression, according to criteria based on multiple editions of the AJCC's Cancer Staging Manual.

follow_up.recurrence_stage_group.label: Recurrence Stage Group
follow_up.recurrence_stage_group.desc: The code to represent the stage group of the tumour, as assigned by the reporting recurrence_tumour_staging_system, that indicates the overall prognostic tumour stage (ie. Stage I, Stage II, Stage III etc.) at the time of retreatment for a recurrence or disease progression.

follow_up.posttherapy_tumour_staging_sys.label: Post-therapy Tumour Staging System
follow_up.posttherapy_tumour_staging_sys.desc: Specify the tumour staging system used to stage the cancer after treatment for patients receiving systemic and/or radiation therapy alone or as a component of their initial treatment, or as neoadjuvant therapy before planned surgery. This may be represented as ypTNM or ycTNM in the medical report.

follow_up.posttherapy_t_category.label: Post-therapy T Category
follow_up.posttherapy_t_category.desc: The code to represent the extent of the primary tumour (T) based on evidence obtained from clinical assessment parameters determined after treatment for patients receiving systemic and/or radiation therapy alone or as a component of their initial treatment, or as neoadjuvant therapy before planned surgery, according to criteria based on multiple editions of the AJCC's Cancer Staging Manual.

follow_up.posttherapy_n_category.label: Post-therapy N Category
follow_up.posttherapy_n_category.desc: The code to represent the stage of cancer defined by the extent of the regional lymph node (N) involvement for the cancer based on evidence obtained from clinical assessment parameters determined determined after treatment for patients receiving systemic and/or radiation therapy alone or as a component of their initial treatment, or as neoadjuvant therapy before planned surgery, according to criteria based on multiple editions of the AJCC's Cancer Staging Manual.

follow_up.posttherapy_m_category.label: Post-therapy M Category
follow_up.posttherapy_m_category.desc: The code to represent the stage of cancer defined by the extent of the distant metastasis (M) for the cancer based on evidence obtained from clinical assessment parameters determined after treatment for patients receiving systemic and/or radiation therapy alone or as a component of their initial treatment, or as neoadjuvant therapy before planned surgery, according to criteria based on multiple editions of the AJCC's Cancer Staging Manual.

follow_up.posttherapy_stage_group.label: Post-therapy Stage Group
follow_up.posttherapy_stage_group.desc: The code to represent the stage group of the tumour, as assigned by the reporting posttherapy_tumour_staging_system, that indicates the overall prognostic tumour stage (ie. Stage I, Stage II, Stage III etc.) after treatment for patients receiving systemic and/or radiation therapy alone or as a component of their initial treatment, or as neoadjuvant therapy before planned surgery.

exposure.program_id.label: Program ID
exposure.program_id.desc: Unique identifier of the ARGO program.

exposure.submitter_donor_id.label: Submitter Donor ID
exposure.submitter_donor_id.desc: Unique identifier of the donor, assigned by the data provider.

exposure.tobacco_smoking_status.label: Tobacco Smoking Status
exposure.tobacco_smoking_status.desc: Indicate donor's self-reported smoking status and history. (Reference: caDSR CDE ID 2181650)
values: Current reformed smoker, duration not specified
Lifelong non-smoker (<100 cigarettes smoked in lifetime)

exposure.tobacco_type.label: Tobacco Type
exposure.tobacco_type.desc: Indicate the type(s) of tobacco used by donor. (Reference: NCIt CDE C177629)

exposure.pack_years_smoked.label: Pack Years Smoked
exposure.pack_years_smoked.desc: This field applies to cigarettes. Indicate the smoking intensity in Pack Years, where the number of pack years is defined as the number of cigarettes smoked per day times (x) the number of years smoked divided (/) by 20. (Reference: caDSR CDE ID 2955385)

exposure.alcohol_history.label: Alcohol History
exposure.alcohol_history.desc: Indicate if the donor has consumed at least 12 drinks of any alcoholic beverage in their lifetime. (Reference: caDSR CDE ID 2201918)

exposure.alcohol_consumption_category.label: Alcohol Consumption Category
exposure.alcohol_consumption_category.desc: Describe the donor's current level of alcohol use as self-reported by the donor. (Reference: caDSR CDE ID 3457767)
values: Social Drinker (> once a month, < once a week)

exposure.alcohol_type.label: Alcohol Type
exposure.alcohol_type.desc: Indicate the type(s) of alcohol the donor consumes. (Reference: NCIt CDE C173647)

exposure.opiate_use.label: Opiate Use
exposure.opiate_use.desc: Indicate if the donor has ever used opium or other opiates like opium juice, heroin, or Sukhteh regularly (at least weekly over a 6-month period).

exposure.hot_drinks_consumption.label: Hot Drink Consumption
exposure.hot_drinks_consumption.desc: Indicate if the donor regularly drinks tea, coffee, or other hot drinks.

exposure.red_meat_frequency.label: Red Meat Consumption Frequency
exposure.red_meat_frequency.desc: Indicate how frequently the donor eats red meat. Examples of red meat include beef, veal, pork, lamb, mutton, horse, or goat meat.
values: Most days but not every day

exposure.processed_meat_frequency.label: Processed Meat Consumption Frequency
exposure.processed_meat_frequency.desc: Indicate how frequently the patient eats processed meat. Examples of processed meat include hams, salamis, or sausages.
values: Most days but not every day

exposure.soft_drinks_frequency.label: Soft Drink Consumption Frequency
exposure.soft_drinks_frequency.desc: Indicate the frequency of soft drink consumption by the donor.
values: Most days but not every day

exposure.exercise_frequency.label: Exercise Frequency
exposure.exercise_frequency.desc: Indicate how many times per week the donor exercises for at least 30 minutes. (Reference: NCIt CDE C25367)
values: Most days but not every day

exposure.exercise_intensity.label: Exercise Intensity
exposure.exercise_intensity.desc: Indicate the intensity of exercise. (Reference: NCIt CDE C25539)
values: Low: No increase in the heart beat, and no perspiration
Moderate: Increase in the heart beat slightly with some light perspiration
Vigorous: Increase in the heart beat substantially with heavy perspiration

family_history.program_id.label: Program ID
family_history.program_id.desc: Unique identifier of the ARGO program.

family_history.submitter_donor_id.label: Submitter Donor ID
family_history.submitter_donor_id.desc: Unique identifier of the donor, assigned by the data provider.

family_history.family_relative_id.label: Family Relative ID
family_history.family_relative_id.desc: Unique identifier of the relative, assigned by the data provider.

family_history.relative_with_cancer_hist.label: Relative with Cancer History
family_history.relative_with_cancer_hist.desc: Indicate if donor has any genetic relatives with a history of cancer. (Reference: NCIt C159104, caDSR CDE ID 6161023)

family_history.relationship_type.label: Relationship Type
family_history.relationship_type.desc: Indicate genetic relationship of the relative to the donor. (Reference: caDSR CDE ID 2179937)

family_history.gender_of_relative.label: Gender of Relative
family_history.gender_of_relative.desc: The self-reported gender of related individual.

family_history.age_of_relative_at_diagno.label: Age Of Relative At Diagnosis
family_history.age_of_relative_at_diagno.desc: The age (in years) when the donor's relative was first diagnosed. (Reference: caDSR CDE ID 5300571)

family_history.cancer_type_code_of_relat.label: Cancer Type Code (ICD-10) of Relative
family_history.cancer_type_code_of_relat.desc: The code to describe the malignant diagnosis of the donor's relative with a history of cancer using the WHO ICD-10 code (https://icd.who.int/browse10/2019/en) classification.

family_history.relative_vital_status.label: Vital Status of Relative
family_history.relative_vital_status.desc: Relative's last known state of living or deceased.

family_history.cause_of_death_of_relativ.label: Cause of Death of Relative
family_history.cause_of_death_of_relativ.desc: Indicate the cause of the death of the relative.

family_history.relative_survival_time.label: Survival Time Of Relative
family_history.relative_survival_time.desc: Indicate how long, in days, the relative survived from the time they were diagnosed with cancer.

biomarker.program_id.label: Program ID
biomarker.program_id.desc: Unique identifier of the ARGO program.

biomarker.submitter_donor_id.label: Submitter Donor ID
biomarker.submitter_donor_id.desc: Unique identifier of the donor, assigned by the data provider.

biomarker.submitter_specimen_id.label: Submitter Specimen ID
biomarker.submitter_specimen_id.desc: Unique identifier of the specimen, assigned by the data provider.

biomarker.submitter_primary_diagnosis_id.label: Submitter Primary Diagnosis ID
biomarker.submitter_primary_diagnosis_id.desc: If the biomarker test was done at the time of primary diagnosis, then indicate the associated submitter_primary_diagnosis_id here.

biomarker.submitter_treatment_id.label: Submitter Treatment ID
biomarker.submitter_treatment_id.desc: If the biomarker test was done at the initiation of a specific treatment regimen, indicate the associated submitter_treatment_id here.

biomarker.submitter_follow_up_id.label: Submitter Follow-Up ID
biomarker.submitter_follow_up_id.desc: If the biomarker test was done during a follow-up event, then indicate the associated submitter_follow_up_id here.

biomarker.test_interval.label: Interval Of Test
biomarker.test_interval.desc: If the biomarker test was not associated with a specific specimen or follow-up, primary diagnosis or treatment event, then indicate the interval of time since primary diagnosis that the biomarker test was performed at, in days.

biomarker.ca19-9_level.label: CA19-9 Level
biomarker.ca19-9_level.desc: Indicate the level of carbohydrate antigen 19-9 (CA19-9). Carbohydrate antigen 19-9 testing is useful to monitor the response to treatment in pancreatic cancer patients. (Reference: LOINC: 24108-3)

biomarker.crp_levels.label: C-reactive protein (CRP) Level
biomarker.crp_levels.desc: Indicate the quantitative measurement of the amount of CRP, an inflammatory marker, in the blood in mg/L. Used for screening and monitoring for inflammatory disease, infections, and for cardiovascular disease risk assessment. (Reference: NCIt C64548, LOINC 30522-7)

biomarker.ldh_level.label: Lactate Dehydrogenase (LDH) Level
biomarker.ldh_level.desc: Indicate the level of lactate dehydrogenase (LDH), in IU/L. An increased amount of LDH in the blood may be a sign of tissue damage and some types of cancer. (Reference: NCI)

biomarker.anc.label: Absolute Neutrophil Count (ANC)
biomarker.anc.desc: Indicate the value for a hematology laboratory test for the absolute number of neutrophil cells present in a sample of peripheral blood from a donor, in cells/uL. The ANC may be used to check for infection, inflammation, leukemia and other conditions. Cancer treatment such as chemotherapy may reduce the ANC. (Reference: caDSR CDE ID: 2180198)

biomarker.alc.label: Absolute Lymphocyte Count (ALC)
biomarker.alc.desc: Indicate the absolute number of lymphocytes (ALC) found in a given volume of blood, as cells/uL. Lymphocytes help fight off infections and an altered cellular immune function has been demonstrated in patients with cancer. (Reference: NCIt: C113237)

biomarker.brca_carrier.label: BRCA Carrier
biomarker.brca_carrier.desc: Indicate whether donor is a carrier of a mutation in a BRCA gene. A mutation in this gene is associated with an increased risk of familial breast and ovarian cancer.

biomarker.er_status.label: Estrogen Receptor Status
biomarker.er_status.desc: Indicate the expression of estrogen receptor (ER). (Reference: NAACCR 3827)

biomarker.er_allred_score.label: Estrogen Receptor Allred Score
biomarker.er_allred_score.desc: Indicate the Allred score for estrogen receptor. The Allred score is based on the percentage of cells that stain positive by immunohistochemistry (IHC) for estrogen receptor (ER) and the intensity of that staining. (Reference: NAACCR: 3828, caDSR CDE ID 2725288)

biomarker.er_percent_positive.label: Estrogen Receptor Percent Positive
biomarker.er_percent_positive.desc: Indicate a value, in decimals, that represents the percent of cells staining estrogen receptor positive by immunohistochemistry (IHC).

biomarker.her2_ihc_status.label: HER2 IHC Status
biomarker.her2_ihc_status.desc: Indicate the expression of human epidermal growth factor receptor-2 (HER2) assessed by immunohistochemistry (IHC). (Reference: AJCC 8th Edition, Chapter 48)

biomarker.her2_ish_status.label: HER2 ISH Status
biomarker.her2_ish_status.desc: Indicate the expression of human epidermal growth factor receptor-2 (HER2) assessed by in situ hybridization (ISH). (Reference: NAACCR: 3854)

biomarker.pr_status.label: Progesterone Receptor Status
biomarker.pr_status.desc: Indicate the expression of progesterone receptor (PR). (Reference: NAACCR 3915)

biomarker.pr_allred_score.label: Progesterone Receptor Allred Score
biomarker.pr_allred_score.desc: Indicate the Allred score for progesterone receptor. The Allred score is based on the percentage of cells that stain positive by IHC for the progesterone receptor (PR) and the intensity of that staining. (Reference: NAACCR 3916)

biomarker.pr_percent_positive.label: Progesterone Receptor Percent Positive
biomarker.pr_percent_positive.desc: Indicate a value, in decimals, that represents the percent of cells staining progesterone receptor positive by immunohistochemistry (IHC).

biomarker.pd-l1_status.label: PD-L1 Status
biomarker.pd-l1_status.desc: Indicate the immunohistochemical test result that refers to the over-expression or lack of expression of programmed death ligand 1 (PD-L1) in a tissue sample of a primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm. (Reference NCIt: C122807)

biomarker.alk_ihc_status.label: ALK IHC Status
biomarker.alk_ihc_status.desc: Indicate the expression of anaplastic lymphoma receptor tyrosine kinase (ALK) as assessed by immunohistochemistry (IHC). Abnormalities of ALK can be present in lung cancers.

biomarker.alk_ihc_intensity.label: ALK IHC Intensity
biomarker.alk_ihc_intensity.desc: Indicate the intensity of anaplastic lymphoma receptor tyrosine kinase (ALK) as assessed by immunohistochemistry (IHC). Abnormalities of ALK can be present in lung cancers.

biomarker.alk_fish_status.label: ALK FISH Status
biomarker.alk_fish_status.desc: Indicate the expression of anaplastic lymphoma receptor tyrosine kinase (ALK) as assessed by fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH). Abnormalities of ALK can be present in lung cancers.

biomarker.ros1_ihc_status.label: ROS1 IHC Status
biomarker.ros1_ihc_status.desc: Indicate the expression of receptor lymphoma kinase (ROS1) as assessed by immunohistochemistry (IHC). Gene fusions involving ROS1 can be present in lung cancers.

biomarker.pan-trk_ihc_status.label: Pan-TRK IHC Status
biomarker.pan-trk_ihc_status.desc: Indicate the expression of Pan-TRK as assessed by immunohistochemistry (IHC). Pan-TRK IHC screens for neurotrophic tyrosine kinase receptor (NTRK) fusions which have been described in many cancers including lung, thyroid and colorectal cancers.

biomarker.ret_fish_status.label: RET1 FISH Status
biomarker.ret_fish_status.desc: Indicate the expression of gene arrangement involving the RET proto-oncogene (RET1) as assessed by fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH). RET gene rearrangements are associated with several different neoplastic conditions. (Reference: NCIt C46005)

biomarker.hpv_ihc_status.label: HPV IHC Status
biomarker.hpv_ihc_status.desc: Indicate the expression of Human papillomavirus (HPV) p16 as assessed by immunohistochemistry (IHC).

biomarker.hpv_dna_status.label: HPV DNA Status
biomarker.hpv_dna_status.desc: Indicate the expression of Human papillomavirus (HPV) as assessed using a laboratory test in which cells are scraped from the cervix to look for DNA of HPV. (Reference: NCIt C93141)

comorbidity.program_id.label: Program ID
comorbidity.program_id.desc: Unique identifier of the ARGO program.

comorbidity.submitter_donor_id.label: Submitter Donor ID
comorbidity.submitter_donor_id.desc: Unique identifier of the donor, assigned by the data provider.

comorbidity.laterality_of_prior_malignan.label: Laterality at Prior Malignancy
comorbidity.laterality_of_prior_malignan.desc: If donor has history of prior malignancy, indicate laterality of previous diagnosis. (Reference: caDSR CDE ID 4122391)

comorbidity.age_at_comorbidity_diagnosis.label: Age at Comorbidity Diagnosis
comorbidity.age_at_comorbidity_diagnosis.desc: Indicate the age of comorbidity diagnosis, in years.

comorbidity.comorbidity_type_code.label: Comorbidity Type Code
comorbidity.comorbidity_type_code.desc: Indicate the code for the comorbidity using the WHO ICD-10 code classification (https://icd.who.int/browse10/2019/en).

comorbidity.comorbidity_treatment_status.label: Comorbidity Treatment
comorbidity.comorbidity_treatment_status.desc: Indicate if the patient is being treated for the comorbidity (this includes prior malignancies).

comorbidity.comorbidity_treatment.label: Comorbidity Treatment Type
comorbidity.comorbidity_treatment.desc: Indicate treatment details for the comorbidity (this includes prior malignancies).

profiles.title: ALL Risk Assessment Profile
profiles.desc: Risk assessment for acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL).

profiles.title: Body Surface Area
profiles.desc: Entire body surface area, either measured or calculated.

profiles.title: Cancer Disease Status Profile
profiles.desc: A clinician's qualitative judgment on the current trend of the cancer, e.g., whether it is stable, worsening (progressing), or improving (responding). The judgment may be based a single type or multiple kinds of evidence, such as imaging data, assessment of symptoms, tumor markers, laboratory data,

profiles.title: Cancer Patient Profile
profiles.desc: A patient who has been diagnosed with or is receiving medical treatment for a malignant growth or tumor. The only difference between CancerPatient and [US Core Patient](http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition-us-core-patient.html) is that Patient.deceased is a [must-support](https://www.hl7.

profiles.title: Cancer Risk Assessment Profile
profiles.desc: Parent profile for observations regarding cancer risk assessment. Risk assessment is a process used to estimate the risk that a certain event will happen. In medicine, this may include a person’s risk of having a child with a certain condition or disease, such as cancer. It may also be used to estim

profiles.title: Cancer Stage Profile
profiles.desc: Profile for observations regarding cancer stage, grade, or classification. The stage is an assessment of the extent of the cancer in the body, according to a given cancer staging classification system. The key elements are the code, method, value, and optionally, prognostic factors referenced in the

profiles.title: Cancer-Related Medication Administration Profile
profiles.desc: An episode of medication administration for a patient whose condition is related to a primary or secondary cancer condition. In the context of chemotherapy drugs, the medication administration in most cases is performed and documented by the provider.

profiles.title: Cancer-Related Medication Request Profile
profiles.desc: A record of a medication prescription or consumption associated with cancer treatment. The medication may reported by the prescriber, prescribing organization, or patient. It does not have to be directly observed.

profiles.title: Cancer-Related Surgical Procedure Profile
profiles.desc: A surgical action addressing a cancer condition. The scope of this profile has been narrowed to cancer-related procedures by constraining the reasonReference and reasonCode to cancer conditions, one of which is required. If a procedure occurs that is NOT a surgical procedure, use the US Core Procedu

profiles.title: Comorbidities Profile
profiles.desc: General structure for capturing comorbid conditions with respect to a primary ('index') condition. The user can use this profile in three ways: (1) free-form, listing any conditions they wish to highlight as significant comorbidities, (2) following a formal paradigm such as the Charlson Comorbidity

profiles.title: Deauville Scale Profile
profiles.desc: Profile for Deauville Scale. A 5 point scale devised to assess the response to treatment of Hodgkin and aggressive Non-Hodgkin lymphoma.

profiles.title: ECOG Performance Status Profile
profiles.desc: The Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status represents the patient's functional status and is used to determine their ability to tolerate therapies in serious illness, specifically for chemotherapy. (Definition from: [LOINC](https://loinc.org/89262-0/))

profiles.title: Genomic Region Studied Profile
profiles.desc: A subset of genes or genomic regions of interest in a targeted resequencing study.

profiles.title: Genomic Variant Profile
profiles.desc: Details about a set of changes in the tested sample compared to a reference sequence. The term variant can be used to describe an alteration that may be benign, pathogenic, or of unknown significance. The term variant is increasingly being used in place of the term mutation. Variants can be computed

profiles.title: Genomics Report Profile
profiles.desc: Genomic analysis summary report. The report may include one or more tests, with two distinct test types. The first type is a targeted mutation test, where a specific mutation on a specific gene is tested for. The result is either positive or negative for that mutation. The second type is a more gene

profiles.title: Histologic Behavior and Type
profiles.desc: Histologic behavior and type determined from examination of tumor sample. ICD-O-3 morphology codes are referenced in the logical definition but not expanded in the value set for intellectual property reasons. For primary cancers, the ICD-O-3 behavior suffix should be /1, /2, or /3. For secondary can

profiles.title: Histologic Grade
profiles.desc: Histologic grade determined from examination of tumor sample. The grade system should be captured using the method data element.

profiles.title: History of Metastatic Cancer
profiles.desc: Records the existence of a past episode of metastatic cancer, for the purpose of long term management and tracking.

profiles.title: Human Specimen Profile
profiles.desc: A specimen taken from a Patient for the purpose of oncology-related testing. The profile includes extensions to specify a more precise body site and an identifier of source body structure at that site (for example, a tumor identifier).

profiles.title: Karnofsky Performance Status Profile
profiles.desc: The Karnofsky Performance Status (KPS) is a tool used to measure a patient's functional status. It can be used to compare the effectiveness of different therapies and to help assess the prognosis of certain patients, such as those with certain cancers. The KPS score ranges from 0 to 100 in intervals

profiles.title: Lansky Play Performance Status Profile
profiles.desc: The Lansky Play-Performance Status for children is a parent-rated instrument which records usual play activity as the index of performance. It is similar to the Karnofsky Performance Scale for adults (Definition from: [NCI Thesaurus](https://ncithesaurus.nci.nih.gov/ncitbrowser/ConceptReport.jsp?dic

profiles.title: Lymphoma Stage Profile
profiles.desc: Staging of lymphoma (both Hodgkins and Non-Hodgkins) by Ann Arbor, Cotswold, or Lugano staging systems. The method (required) indicates which of these related staging systems was used.

profiles.title: Parent for T, N, and M Categories.
profiles.desc: Parent profile for T, N, and M category profiles.

profiles.title: Primary Cancer Condition Profile
profiles.desc: Records the primary cancer condition, the original or first neoplasm in the body (Definition from: [NCI Dictionary of Cancer Terms](https://www.cancer.gov/publications/dictionaries/cancer-terms/def/primary-tumor)). Cancers that are not clearly secondary (i.e., of uncertain origin or behavior) should

profiles.title: Radiotherapy Course Summary Profile
profiles.desc: A summary of a course of radiotherapy delivered to a patient. It records the treatment intent, termination reason, modalities, techniques, number of sessions, and doses delivered to one or more body volumes. Whether the course has been fully delivered or stopped is indicated in the status element.

profiles.title: Radiotherapy Volume Profile
profiles.desc: A volume of the body used in radiotherapy planning or treatment delivery.

profiles.title: Rhabdomyocaroma Risk Assessment Profile
profiles.desc: Risk assessment for rhabdomyocaroma. The assessment is based on three things - TNM stage, clinical group, and whether cancer cells have a PAX/FOX01 fusion gene.

profiles.title: Secondary Cancer Condition Profile
profiles.desc: Records the history of secondary neoplasms, including location(s) and the date of onset of metastases. A secondary cancer results from the spread (metastasization) of cancer from its original site (Definition from: NCI Dictionary of Cancer Terms).

profiles.title: TNM Distant Metastases Category Profile
profiles.desc: Category describing the extent of a tumor metastasis in remote anatomical locations, based on evidence such as physical examination, imaging, and/or biopsy.

profiles.title: TNM Primary Tumor Category Profile
profiles.desc: Category of the primary tumor, based on its size and extent, based on evidence such as physical examination, imaging, and/or biopsy.

profiles.title: TNM Regional Nodes Category Profile
profiles.desc: Category of the presence or absence of metastases in regional lymph nodes, based on evidence such as physical examination, imaging, and/or biopsy.

profiles.title: TNM Stage Group Profile
profiles.desc: Reporting of the stage group representing the overall extent of a cancer, based on AJCC staging guidelines.

profiles.title: Tumor Marker Test Profile
profiles.desc: The result of a tumor marker test. Tumor marker tests are generally used to guide cancer treatment decisions and monitor treatment, as well as to predict the chance of recovery and cancer recurrence.

profiles.title: Tumor Morphology Report
profiles.desc: Tumor morphology can include information on the type of cell (type), the malignant potential of the tumor (behavior), and the degree of differentiation (grade). For some cancers, the type and behavior are described in the ICD-O-3 code.

profiles.title: Tumor Profile
profiles.desc: Identifies a tumor that has not been removed from the body. Whenever possible, a single resource conforming to this profile will be used to track a tumor over time (as opposed to creating new Tumor-conforming BodyStructure resources each time that tumor is measured). Use HumanSpecimen to represent t

profiles.title: Tumor Size Profile
profiles.desc: Records the dimensions of a tumor

profiles.title: mCODE Patient Bundle Profile
profiles.desc: A collection of data for an mCODE cancer patient.

profiles.title: mCODE Patient Group Profile
profiles.desc: A group of patients included in the scope of mCODE, whose cancer-related resources conform to mCODE profiles.
